Specify cohort-enrichment options

Source: R/pipeline_options.R
enrichment_options.Rd

Configure cohort classification, comorbidity scoring, and injury-severity scoring.

Usage

enrichment_options(
  analysis_level = c("admission", "icu"),
  icds_inj_path = NULL,
  classify_fn = NULL,
  classify_args = list(),
  maps = c("charlson", "elixhauser"),
  icd_adjudication_path = NULL,
  publish = TRUE
)

Arguments

analysis_level

Character string, "admission" or "icu", specifying the analysis level for cohort information and annotations. Default: "admission".

icds_inj_path

Character string giving an injury-ICD input file for build_cohort_annotations(), or NULL to use that function's configured input.

classify_fn

Optional classification function used by build_cohort_info_general() or build_cohort_annotations(). Default: NULL, which for the scid cohort profile resolves to scid_classify(); supplying a function here replaces that default rather than adding to it.

classify_args

Named list of additional arguments supplied to classify_fn. Default: an empty list. Entries are merged over the profile's own defaults, so a single path can be overridden without restating the others.

maps

Character vector containing "charlson", "elixhauser", or both. Selects the maps used by run_comorbidities(). Default: both.

icd_adjudication_path

Character string giving a reviewed eICU ICD-version crosswalk for comorbidity and injury scoring. NULL uses the scoring function's default resolution.

publish

Logical. Write computed comorbidity and injury scores to their database tables. Default: TRUE.

Value

A named list of the supplied options, suitable for the enrichment argument of run_one_source() and compatible direct stage functions.

Details

These settings configure selected enrichment stages. Use stages in run_one_source() to choose which operations to run.

Only explicitly supplied arguments are included in the result, including explicit NULL values. Omitted settings use the defaults of the receiving function. An empty options list therefore leaves its defaults unchanged.

See also

pipeline_options, run_one_source()

Examples

enrichment_options(analysis_level = "icu")
#> $analysis_level
#> [1] "icu"
#> 
enrichment_options(maps = "charlson")
#> $maps
#> [1] "charlson"
#>
